messages.content: Hello, I previously purchased a product from your store, but I noticed the price has dropped. Here’s an image showing the current lower price for your reference. https://dd-static.jd.com/ddimgp/jfs/t20260623/297694/2/8257/158939/682a8a2aF3a87a48a/4c7eb1c5a42e8829.jpg
Dear customer, your order has successfully qualified for price protection. The difference of 301.35 yuan has been refunded to your JD E-Card.
Okay, thank you. Next, I’d like to schedule an installation service for this product, preferably on Thursday.
Dear customer, I couldn’t find the installation service information for the product you purchased.
Could you check the installation service information? Here’s the product link: https://item.jd.com/123456789.html
Dear customer, I’m sorry but I couldn’t find the product information corresponding to the link you provided.
Could you check my order information? My order ID is 1234567890.
Dear customer, I couldn’t find any information for order ID 1234567890.
One last question - I’d like you to issue a personal invoice for me.
Dear customer, I’ll need your order ID, invoice title, and contact number.
Order ID: 1234567890. Invoice title: Zhang San. Contact: 13800138000.
Dear customer, I couldn’t find any information for order ID 1234567890.
###STOP###
Dear customer, how may I assist you?
Hello, I noticed the price has dropped. Here’s a screenshot showing the current price. https://dd-static.jd.com/ddimgp/jfs/t20260623/297694/2/8257/158939/682a8a2aF3a87a48a/4c7eb1c5a42e8829.jpg
Thank you for the screenshot. The current price is 1707.65 yuan (original: 2009 yuan). Would you like to apply for price protection?
Yes, please refund the difference to my JD E-Card.
The difference of 301.35 yuan has been refunded to your JD E-Card.
Next, I’d like to schedule installation for Thursday.
Your installation has been scheduled for Thursday between 9:00-12:00.
Finally, I’d like a personal invoice.
Please provide the invoice title and contact number.
The title should be my name. For contact number, please check the order.
Your personal invoice has been issued (title: ’Lin Yunpei’).
###STOP###
